items.name: tokens
items.title: 76° tokens
items.description: The 76° foundation: tokens.css (the only file allowed to contain color literals), base.css (reset, focus contract, mono/tabular utilities), and the cx class combiner.

items.name: band
items.title: Band
items.description: The ink chrome zone: topbar with wordmark and horizontal nav, mono sub-tabs, and the page hero. One job: Carry ALL navigation and page context, so the paper below is 100% work.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet & Row
items.description: The platinum wall and its 12-col grid — including the signature -44px overlap row. One job: Hold the paper: grid, gutters, and the one overlap per page.

items.name: stat-s1
items.title: StatS1
items.description: The signature stat and the only legal KPI card: label + delta, icon tile + value, and a footnote that earns its line. One job: Answer "how much — and so what."

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Value against target with one 3px bar. The numbers are the information; the bar is illustration. One job: Answer "how far along."

items.name: trend
items.title: Trend
items.description: Flat single-weight SVG lines on a hairline grid — seed for now, line-gray for before. No fills; the draw-in is off until the app asks. One job: Answer "which direction."

items.name: meter-list
items.title: MeterList
items.description: Named items with 3px bars and mandatory absolute numbers — the donut chart's replacement. One job: Answer "how is each part doing."

items.name: distribution-strip
items.title: DistributionStrip
items.description: One total divided into its shares: a 10px strip with structural seams and a legend that prints every figure. One job: Answer "what share is each part."

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: The ERP workhorse: mono headers, mono IDs, dot+word statuses, right-aligned tabular numbers, full keyboard contract. One job: Answer "what exactly happened."

items.name: card-tabs
items.title: CardTabs
items.description: In-card filter tabs on the card hairline — honest ARIA in both of its two modes. One job: Filter one card's content in place.

items.name: activity-list
items.title: ActivityList
items.description: A mono timestamp column beside sentence rows with bold entities. Absolute time, always. One job: Answer "what needs me."

items.name: sum-list
items.title: SumList
items.description: The amount block — a set of charges and the figure they add up to. One job: State a set of amounts and the figure they add up to.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Native <button> with four registered variants — no shadows, no transforms, one primary per view region. One job: Trigger exactly one named action.

items.name: status-word
items.title: StatusWord
items.description: A 6px currentColor dot + a colored word. The word is the meaning; the dot is rhythm. One job: State the status of one thing, in one word.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: The paper primitive: one shadow, one radius, zero border. Every widget composes it. One job: Be the sheet of paper a widget is printed on.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Native <dialog> in a paper card on a flat scrim — focus trap, Esc, and top layer for free. One job: Interrupt for one decision or one form.

items.name: toast
items.title: Notification
items.description: Bottom-left paper notifications — title, description, icon, four tones, two sizes. Errors still render inline first. One job: Report that something happened, without demanding attention.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: The popover attribute in the top layer: ink card, 300ms delay, focus-visible triggers included. One job: Add one line of supplementary context to a control.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: One soft sentence + one primary action. No illustration, no humor, max two lines. One job: Say what would appear here, why it is empty, and the one way forward.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Static wall-colored blocks matching the target anatomy. No shimmer, no pulse, 300ms gate. One job: Hold the exact shape of content that is still loading.

items.name: search-command
items.title: SearchCommand
items.description: The ⌘K palette every 76° app ships — dialog anatomy, mono input, grouped results. One job: Be the keyboard front door to everything.

items.name: code-block
items.title: CodeBlock
items.description: Code as a quotation: monospace, ink, an inset panel on wall — and no syntax highlighting, ever. One job: Print code or a command exactly as it must be typed.

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: One component that styles a whole subtree — markdown, on-system. One job: Set running copy the system did not author.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: The searchable select — ARIA 1.2 combobox pattern, hand-rolled, zero dependencies. One job: Pick one value — or a set of them — from a list too long to scan.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: An actions dropdown on the native popover top layer — plus the SplitButton that carries one. One job: Hold the secondary VERBS one control cannot.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: The slide-over: a paper panel from the screen edge for detail-in-context, on native <dialog>. One job: Inspect or edit ONE record without leaving the sheet.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: The inline notice — where B14 sends every error: in the flow, at the point of relevance. One job: State a condition of THIS place, in this place.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small mono tag for category metadata — never status, never numbers that matter. One job: Name the CATEGORY a thing belongs to.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: The non-modal panel on the native popover attribute — a few controls beside their trigger, 320px at the widest. One job: Hold a FEW controls beside the control that asked for them.

items.name: plate
items.title: Plate
items.description: The band-less page — one card on the bare wall, under the mono 76° wordmark. One job: Carry a single decision on a page that has no navigation.

items.name: split
items.title: Split
items.description: The band-less page cut in half, with the card across the cut. One job: Carry a single decision on the line between two surfaces.

items.name: pin-field
items.title: PinField
items.description: The verification-code input — N boxes that are one value, with B11 field chrome. One job: Enter a short fixed-length code.

items.name: social-button
items.title: SocialButton
items.description: The federated-identity button — B10 Ghost anatomy, one currentColor mark, no brand hex. One job: Hand authentication to ONE named provider.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Native <details> sections on hairlines — secondary detail, folded away. One job: Fold SECONDARY detail out of the way until it is asked for.

items.name: description-list
items.title: DescriptionList
items.description: The record readout — mono terms, informative values, on hairlines. One job: State a set of labelled facts about ONE record.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: One hairline, optionally naming the group below it in mono. One job: Separate two groups that share a surface.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person, named — initials on wall, or their photo if the product has one. One job: Identify a PERSON beside their name.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner & Busy
items.description: The wait, stated — the one continuous animation the system allows. One job: State that a region is fetching, and name what.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key, printed — mono cap on wall, for shortcuts that exist. One job: Print the key that triggers something.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A hairline row on the wall — the sheet's whole content region, switched. One job: Switch which set of cards the sheet shows, without touching the URL.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A fixed sequence, stated — where you are, and what remains. One job: State where you are in a FIXED sequence, and what remains.

items.name: tree-list
items.title: TreeList
items.description: The full ARIA tree, hand-rolled — depth drawn, one tab stop, no dependency. One job: Move through a HIERARCHY whose depth is itself the information.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: One record's history on a clipped rail — including what has not happened. One job: State the ordered HISTORY of ONE record, with the gaps visible.

items.name: field
items.title: Forms
items.description: Field, Select, Checkbox, Radio, Toggle — labels above, seed focus without glow, errors that say how to fix. One job: Collect one value per control, honestly labeled.

items.name: error-summary
items.title: ErrorSummary
items.description: The top-of-form index B11 has always required and the barrel never had. One job: Index a failed submit's field errors as one list of links to the fields that caused them.

items.name: number-field
items.title: NumberField
items.description: The quantity input — native number, B11 chrome, a − / + pair, stated unit. One job: Enter a bounded QUANTITY.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A native range in 76° clothes — position matters, and the number is still printed. One job: Set a value whose POSITION in a range matters more than its digits.

items.name: date-range-field
items.title: DateRangeField
items.description: Two native date inputs, a mono preset row, and a context line — no month grid, ever. One job: Choose a DATE RANGE.

items.name: search-field
items.title: SearchField
items.description: The in-place filter — native search, B11 chrome, one named clear, a live count. One job: Filter a set that is ALREADY on screen by typing.

items.name: file-field
items.title: FileField
items.description: The attachment field — a dashed target, a real file input behind a named button, one row per file stating its outcome. One job: Attach files, and state what happened to each one.

items.name: masthead
items.title: Masthead
items.description: The hero, refused as imagery and rebuilt as type. One job: Open a public page with the claim, set in type.

items.name: feature-list
items.title: FeatureList
items.description: The claim, itemised — type on hairlines, never icon tiles. One job: State what the product does, one item at a time.

items.name: cta
items.title: CallToAction
items.description: The last row of a public page — the only one that asks. One job: Name the one act the page wants.

items.name: proof-row
items.title: ProofRow
items.description: The figures that carry the claim, between vertical hairlines. One job: State the few figures that prove the claim.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: SiteFooter
items.description: The one place a page is allowed to be a list of links. One job: Close a public page with everything it owes the reader.

items.name: index-row
items.title: IndexRow
items.description: The cover's contents strip — numbered sections on vertical hairlines. One job: State a publication's sections as a numbered strip, and link to them.

items.name: caption-row
items.title: CaptionRow
items.description: Up to four short fragments spread across one rule. One job: State up to four short captions across one rule.

items.name: block-stats-row
items.title: Stats row
items.description: The four-up S1 row that overlaps the band on every overview.

items.name: block-trend-panel
items.title: Trend panel
items.description: A card with in-card range filters and a two-series trend.

items.name: block-table-view
items.title: Table view
items.description: A filtered, paginated data table with a card head action.

items.name: block-activity-panel
items.title: Activity panel
items.description: A timestamped feed with bold entities.

items.name: block-meter-panel
items.title: Meter panel
items.description: Part-by-part utilization — the donut replacement.

items.name: block-empty-screen
items.title: Empty screen
items.description: A calm empty state with exactly one action.

items.name: block-dashboard-header
items.title: Dashboard header
items.description: The ink band: topbar, sub-tabs, and page hero.

items.name: template-marketing-home
items.title: Public home
items.description: The public surface — a masthead, figures, columns, one ask.

items.name: template-pricing-page
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Pricing as a DataTable — no tier cards, no "Most popular" pill.

items.name: template-invoice-checkout
items.title: Invoice
items.description: A document a business sends and a customer pays — and it prints.

items.name: template-payment-checkout
items.title: Checkout
items.description: A card payment in the shape people expect, refusing what 76° refuses.

items.name: template-erp-purchase-order
items.title: Purchase order
items.description: One operational document — its facts, its lines, its history, its verbs.

items.name: template-crm-deal-board
items.title: Deal board
items.description: The pipeline as a board — four stage cards, and a deal that moves by a named verb.

items.name: template-erp-dashboard
items.title: ERP dashboard
items.description: A warehouse operations overview — the densest 76° screen.

items.name: template-crm-pipeline
items.title: CRM pipeline
items.description: A sales pipeline — stages, momentum, and deals.

items.name: template-pos-terminal
items.title: POS terminal
items.description: A point-of-sale register — scaled up, touch-first.

items.name: template-settings-account
items.title: Settings
items.description: An account settings screen — the forms showcase as a page.

items.name: template-ai-control-center
items.title: AI agent control center
items.description: An ops console for a fleet of AI agents.

items.name: template-analytics-overview
items.title: Analytics overview
items.description: A marketing analytics screen — and the donut it refuses to draw.

items.name: template-auth-sign-in
items.title: Sign in
items.description: The credential screen: three providers, the form, and one seed button.

items.name: template-auth-stacked
items.title: Sign in · stacked band
items.description: The other Split orientation — ink across the top, the card over its edge.

items.name: template-auth-sign-up
items.title: Create account
items.description: Registration — the password rule stated up front, no strength meter.

items.name: template-auth-forgot
items.title: Forgot password
items.description: Request a reset link, with the same answer for every address.

items.name: template-auth-reset
items.title: Reset password
items.description: Set a new password from a link — or state that the link is dead.

items.name: template-auth-verify
items.title: Verify email
items.description: A six-digit code, judged on submit.

items.name: template-auth-invite
items.title: Accept invitation
items.description: Join a workspace, on a named invitation.
